title: Florida SB 54 (2021) - Motor Vehicle Insurance, bill history
claims: CS/CS/SB 54 (2021) was titled Motor Vehicle Insurance and its description includes repealing provisions which comprise the Florida Motor Vehicle No-Fault Law.
The Senate's bill history for CS/CS/SB 54 shows an entry dated June 29, 2021 reading that the bill was vetoed by the Governor, with companion bills passed, see CS/SB 420 (Ch. 2021-96).
The bill history shows a veto message received entry dated November 12, 2021 and a veto message transmitted to the Secretary of State entry dated March 15, 2022.
updateCadence: Static bill history; check each Florida session for new repeal attempts.
statusNote: CS/CS/SB 54 (2021) passed both chambers, the Senate 37-3 and the House 100-16, and was then vetoed by the Governor on June 29, 2021. The bill history records the last action as "3/15/2022 Senate - Veto Message transmitted to Secretary of State". It never became law, so the no-fault repeal it proposed did not take effect. A companion measure, CS/SB 420, was enacted as Chapter 2021-96. Cited for legislative history only.
